query: WITH picked AS (SELECT s.workspace_id,s.id FROM assistant_conversation_sources s JOIN assistant_conversations c ON c.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND c.id=s.conversation_id JOIN assistant_sessions a ON a.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND a.id=s.session_id WHERE c.state<>'deleted' AND c.expires_at>now() AND s.state<>'final' AND s.remote_deleted_at IS NULL AND a.state<>'cleaned' AND (a.state='closed' OR a.expires_at<=now() OR a.last_seen_at<=now()-interval '15 minutes' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=a.login_id AND t.expires_at>now())) ORDER BY s.last_reconcile_attempt_at NULLS FIRST,s.created_at,s.id LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE assistant_conversation_sources s SET last_reconcile_attempt_at=now() FROM picked p WHERE s.workspace_id=p.workspace_id AND s.id=p.id RETURNING s.provider_conversation_id,s.agent_id
